_about: Lesson 7 step 2 (rule-needs-check, Sam option 1): every rule as a proven promise. status: proven (a kittest runs its check on a saved earlier mistake, named in example) | partly (proven, but a known miss is not yet in the test) | judge (a taste rule; proven by a critic-bench case) | next (buildable; plan says how) | owed (another named build delivers the proof) | cannot yet (learn says what the project must learn first; listed for Sam). "by hand" is never a status. rank: worst first by step 1 numbers. Read by source/ruleproofs.py.
